title: Amgen Scholars Program
institution: National University of Singapore, Department of Biological Sciences
about: NUS hosts Amgen Scholars Asia undergraduates for a summer research attachment starting 31 May 2027. The program is open only to undergraduates at universities in Asia; online applications open 1 November 2026 and close 1 February 2027, 18:00 SGT.
requirements: The Asia Program is limited to undergraduate students attending colleges and universities across the Asia region
All documents should be ready before completing the online application; 3 days are allocated for document uploading

upskill.name: AI for Research & Information Synthesis
why: "summer research attachment" (description) → "Summarize long or complex materials while preserving the main arguments, evidence, conclusions, and important contextual details."
"Biological sciences and biotechnology research" (field) → "Use AI to explore, organize, and structure information collected from multiple documents or professional sources."
